scope: static short-cycle conflict compilation for minimum-order all-new-vertices-cubic Type-T port completions

claims.phase1_c4_conflicts: C4 conflicts cannot exist beyond the base local-safety screen (m>=2 required, floor(4/3)=1<2)
claims.phase1_c8_conflicts: every C8 conflict uses exactly m=2 hub passages, support size 1 or 2
claims.phase1_c16_conflicts: every C16 conflict uses 2<=m<=5 hub passages, support size v<=5
claims.phase2_c4_c8_compilation: COMPUTATIONALLY_CERTIFIED for all three j=4 instances (4,55,7), (4,2,2), (4,28,4)
claims.phase3_c16_hypergraph: superseded by the passage-level projection -- see manifests/type_t_port_c16_passage_manifest.json and type_t_port_c16_passage_projection.md; the gadget-level general-m search here reached only the m=2 diagnostic stage (2,509,952 raw candidates, ~37 minutes) before the pivot
claims.phase5_static_sat: not yet attempted at gadget level; not needed there given the passage-level pivot

c4.note: confirms the Phase 1 proof that m=1 is the only possibility for C4 (floor(4/3)=1) and m>=2 is always required, so no search is even needed; the search was run anyway as a cross-check and found nothing, as predicted

c8.note: verification_rejected counts candidates the fast reachability-index filter proposed that did not materialize into an actual simple C8 when independently checked by edge_path_cycle; this is expected (the filter is a sound-and-complete-recall but not exact existence test) and confirms the second detector is doing real work

c16_hypergraph.note: general m in {2,...,5} enumerator design/implementation in progress; the m=2-specialized algorithm used for C4/C8 does not directly generalize because its endpoint-symmetry trick only applies to the final (closing) passage

verification.method: every emitted support independently re-verified by materializing exactly its named hubs and locating the literal cycle via edge_path_cycle (edge plus exact-length simple avoiding path), a differently organized detector reused unmodified from verifier/type_t_port_multipole_check.py
